verdict.rationale: Postmark's pricing pages document customizable data retention from a 45-day default up to 365 days, sold as a $5/month 'Custom activity retention' add-on for Pro plans or higher. Deletion controls are only indirect: the Servers API can delete a whole server and message streams can be archived. Missing for 10: per-message or per-recipient data deletion API, documentation of how retention settings are configured or purged, GDPR/erasure workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
